title: Research: fuse 128 of PR #2586's 416 P104 physical-dual endpoint conversions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2586 charges 416 endpoint H1 conversions in its corrected P104 physical inverse-transpose. This successor fuses 128 of them with neighboring same-register transports: 102 Y entries and 26 X exits. It preserves the complete physical boundary, all 3104 ADDs in order, 208 scalar signs, 150 dirty helper inputs and eight exact-zero private erasures.

The complete word drops from 5398 to 5270 events and 2070 to 1942 positive transports. Rank mass remains 3542. The new local profile is:

`1504 H1 + 58 H2 + 74 H3 + 93 H4 + 57 H5 + 57 H6 + 91 H7 + 8 H8`.

Each pair replaces `H1+Hr` by `H(r+1)`, with r=2..6 occurring 16, 28, 39, 30, 15 times. Thus its local child sum strictly improves for every 0 < p = 1-a < 1 at fixed caller width. A written Clifford block-rank argument, bound to all 416 runs, proves the endpoint-run rank-mass minimum 928 and the child-moment optimum in this restricted rewrite class. The other 288 endpoint conversions meet ADD barriers. This is a finite construction and scoped proof, not an unrestricted circuit optimum, complete supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

All unchanged native implementations are inherited from PR2586 rather than rerun. Intrinsic caller adaptation, global owners and idle/residual costs, physical scalar/address work, rounded private erasure, precision/tape, all-size admission and the remaining 102 forward corrections remain open. No selected cold replay or hosted CI pass is claimed.

## Task and overlap

The claim is in [discussion #2619](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2619). The complete structured task card is `research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion/TASK.json`.

- **Task ID / scope key:** `scalar-to-moment` / `9dbfd943f23ef75bae31`; refined object `PR2586/physical-dual/416-endpoint-conversions/role-local-transport-fusion`, priority revision 4.
- **Base / exact sources:** canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; retained PR2586 `7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1` WORD/README/RESULT bytes. The three live source files (fixture, exact compiler, independent native interpreter) are pinned by Git blob and SHA-256 in SOURCES.json; the retained PR bytes are pinned in PREDECESSORS.json.
- **Question:** which endpoint conversions compose across only disjoint events and scalar signs, and what exact full transport profile and physical map result?
- **Scope status:** changed. Take PR2586's explicit central handoff instead of the generic scalar-simplification example; this is a partially corrected P104 dual's implementation step, not completion of the whole P104 supplier gate.
- **Changed restriction:** separately charged endpoint transports may be fused; ADD source/target uses and private-lifetime events remain barriers. No scalar resynthesis or owner-model change.
- **Method / domain:** all 416 endpoint runs of the fixed 5398-event word, 358 arbitrary public registers, eight private lifetimes and 9 address bits; exact rational/F2/Gaussian arithmetic and a complete word rewrite. Any number of monomials and positive children is allowed within each fixed run for the scoped lower bound.
- **Nearest work / delta:** [PR2586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2586) constructs the physical dual and explicitly asks for endpoint fusion. [PR2551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2551) distinguishes its boundary from backward-chart duals. PR2550 supplies the complementary-frame idea; PR2572 is a different pooled forward word. Concurrent PR2521 native checking and PR2594 combined growth concern different inputs and obligations.
- **Budget / success:** complete local invoice above, strict moment decrease only with other charges fixed; preserve every scalar/private operation and physical endpoint. No global improvement is inferred from the local profile.
- **Stop rule / evidence:** bounded 60-minute session, stop after all 416 runs, 128 new native recipes, complete logical endpoints and semantic controls; no search over changed ADD schedules.
- **Credit / artifact:** predecessors below; `research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion/`; registered reproduction below.

Contextual dependency heads retained by PR2586 are PR2497 `7f2cf129d42030d3eb3975b7d1b07392c6d32a1b`, PR2551 `249c4034da118da35f1e6009744b81461172bc61`, and PR2550 `8af7c324714866afa199e4b7bf80a8f82e56d6f3`. Their executables are not imported by this successor.

Freshness: main and PR2586 were fetched unchanged at 2026-10-15T16:26:01Z; priority revision 4 and selected record unchanged. The last scoped overlap search at 16:27:47Z used 812 open PRs fetched 16:22:35Z and 1276 Discussion records fetched 16:27:10Z, both completely paginated. It found this investigation, PR2586 and PR2551, with no additional matching endpoint-fusion result. Expected offline warnings remain; metadata search does not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. Queries and coverage are retained in TASK.json.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library, no network required:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion/verify.py --regenerate
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-endpoint-fusion
```

Expected primary output:

```text
PASS_P104_DUAL_ENDPOINT_FUSION pairs=128 blocked=288 transports=1942 rank_mass=3542 columns=358 native=128 zero_erases=8 controls=9 no_new_kappa
```

Passed: complete literal word regeneration; 128164 boundary coefficients for each original/candidate replay; eight exact-zero erasures; 416 intrinsic block ranks; 128 new native recipes checked against both direct chart and two-old-edge compositions (256 signed-Pauli plus exact-phase comparisons); complete native regeneration; independent dependency census; nine semantic rejecting controls and an equivalent-frame positive control. The default verifier imports neither the compiler nor predecessor builder/checker code.

All six behavioral tests pass: optimized Git-free read-only export, complete regeneration, executable-source drift rejected before execution, predecessor pin rejection, typed receipt drift, and exclusive output. The final stricter FileExistsError assertion was rerun successfully. Metadata/pins, selected baseline bindings, the card's R439 positive fixture and `git diff --cached --check` pass. Registered replay takes about 15 seconds here. These finite checks support the written arguments; they are not a formal multiplication proof or independent human review.

The exact result receipt, full candidate and new recipes are committed in RESULT.json, WORD.json and NATIVE.json. Unchecked obligations are listed above and in TASK.json. In particular, this does not rerun PR2586's entire unchanged 1245-recipe native certificate.

## Open next questions

The package README's open questions and TASK.json identify two bounded steps. First, derive one explicitly charged two-register compensation that moves a blocked conversion across an ADD while retaining the physical boundary; a plain commute fails. Second, price an actual owner window for the new rank 3–7 children and decreasing endpoint edges, retaining private erasure and all idle/residual obligations. These gaps prevent converting the local profile improvement into supplier admission.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The source's concrete fusion handoff and explicit package hook made this a small, reproducible contribution. The main friction was the fast-moving shared board.
